name: nginx.http2_off
description: Turn HTTP/2 off everywhere nginx reads config, as a stopgap until a fixed nginx is installed: nginx.conf and every file it includes (sites-enabled, conf.d, snippets), in place. It removes the http2 flag from every listen in an http server (the flag turns HTTP/2 on for the whole address and port, so one left on turns it back on for every server there) and changes http2 on to http2 off in http{} and each server. QUIC (HTTP/3) listens are left alone. Each changed file is backed up under /var/backups/nginx-http2 first, keeping mode and owner, with the exact lines changed; then nginx -t and a reload. If either fails, every file is put back and nginx reloaded as it was. Does nothing when HTTP/2 is already off. The dry run (and the nginx_http2 state tool) prints the lines it would change.
health_check: nginx -t and the reload pass; otherwise every file is put back.
